Metadata.Name: Expense Approval Workflow
Metadata.Description: A complete expense approval process with form submission, manager approval, branching logic, and database updates.
Metadata.Author: Demo

Step.Title: Submit Expense
Step.Description: User fills out the expense form

Step.Title: Manager Approval
Step.Description: Manager reviews and approves or rejects the expense

Step.Title: Record Approval
Step.Description: Update expense status to approved in database

Step.Title: Notify Rejection
Step.Definition: {"to":"$input.requester_email","subject":"Expense Request Rejected","body":"Your expense request has been rejected. Please contact your manager for details.","next_step_ids":[]}

Step.Title: Notify Approval
Step.Description: Send approval confirmation to requester and finance team
Step.Definition: {"to":"$input.requester_email","subject":"Expense Approved","body":"Your expense request has been approved. Finance will process payment within 5 business days.","next_step_ids":[]}

Form.name: Expense Submission Form
Form.Description: Form for submitting expense requests with amount, category, and receipt details.

Group.name: Managers
Group.Description: Department managers with approval authority for expenses.

Group.name: Finance
